summary: The whole-PRD delivery audit of Kiln Run Restart at 522e983 found 10 of 23 criteria not fully built, with eleven missing parts, each small. Phase 4 completes stopped-phase recovery: AC-CASE-01, 02 and 04, and AC-CARRY-04, 05 and 06. Phase 5 completes starting from an existing branch: AC-FROM-01, 03 and 04, and AC-CURRENT-01. The audit ran four rounds, the cap, and the fourth still confirmed new gaps. No criterion was amended, and no behavior was found changed outside the requirements.
